This matches AGENT_CONTRACT section 3's named bypass class exactly (a lane operating outside the lease system) and is the identical incident shape the section cites (P-155/P-159 colliding on hauska-engine-api traffic within minutes). gh pr list --search P-177 confirms two of P-177's PRs (#670, #671) touched artifacts/api-server directly in the hours before this lane started. Fixing this needs a new vocabulary entry, which this mission explicitly excludes ('New vocabulary tokens' is out of scope) -- flagged for the row that owns vocabulary additions.

hauska-engine site-model.ts:658-660's hardcoded 'pending — buildable-envelope atom not yet on file' override: documented, deliberate, and correctly reasoned (avoids leaking a raw figure per Ruling B), but it means the PDF and the MCP will never say byte-identical things for the buildable-with-area/provisional dispositions even after every other P-167 defect is fixed, unless a new shared token is minted or the two wordings are accepted as a permanent documented exception.

The P-152/P-154 setback-number three-way disagreement (panel atom-chain vs MCP record vs PDF's own per-parcel adapter) is still fully live on 2026-09-13 for both Bastrop probe parcels and drives most of the FAIL verdicts here; it is not this lane's to fix, but it means P-167 cannot pass structurally until P-152/P-154 land, independent of any pure-vocabulary fix.

missionPremise: OPS-23 P-167 (wave 4): the display vocabulary is one versioned subpath of @empressaio/atom-contract imported identically by hauska-map, hauska-engine and legacy-design-tools with the parity locks retired; the row's completion predicate is that the actual customer-visible strings match byte-for-byte across the panel, the MCP and the PDF for the fixed parcel set (R-4: the customer surface is the predicate, not a merge or a package version).
completionPredicate: PASS requires, per parcel: displayStringsIdentical=true (panel, MCP and PDF agree byte-for-byte on every string a customer would read for that parcel's disposition) AND globally: parityLockDeleted=true, packageVersion=latest, importers=[hauska-map,hauska-engine,legacy-design-tools] all verified at pin. This lane closes the global half (pin, lockfile, no parity lock, engine-api revision content-verified) but the per-parcel half FAILS on all five parcels for concrete, cited, non-speculative reasons -- so the row is not done, and this close says so rather than reporting the pin as if it were the whole predicate.
scopeBasis: OPS-23 sections 0, 2 (F19), 3 (R-1..R-6), 7; mission_p167_pdf_leg.md's explicit four build items and three out-of-scope exclusions (no new vocabulary tokens, no engine deploy tooling beyond what exists). The cortex-api traffic-shift deferral is scoped by AGENT_CONTRACT section 3's deploy-traffic lease law and its named-bypass clause, applied to a live, verified concurrent-use signal rather than a hypothetical one.
